item.title: Bulletin updated at 07:50 HKT 25/Aug/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A southerly airstream will bring showers to the coast of southern China today. Under the influence of an anticyclone aloft, the weather will improve over Guangdong during the weekend and early next week. Winds will be weak and the weather will be very hot over the coastal areas. Tropical Cyclone Saola is expected to linger over the east of the Luzon Strait in the next few days and intensify gradually. It will then move in the general direction of the vicinity of Taiwan and the coast of southeastern China, but its movement would remain uncertain.
